_why: Which base_harness/ directories the console may launch as a *task* harness. The directory holds more than that: `oracle` runs the dataset's own reference solution, `codex`/`opencode` are also registered as improver-side harnesses, and the six adapters translate somebody else's agent rather than stating anything about ours. Declaring the set here keeps the console from hard-coding it while still refusing to offer the rest; making another directory launchable is one line in this file, not a code change. The platform's two test instruments are deliberately not here at all: `loop_plain` (the deterministic floor) and `cli_agent` (the generic CLI wrapper) live in tests/fixtures/base_harness/ since 2026-11-01, because neither is a harness a study may start from.
